mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recordings (session_id, started_at, base_wall_clock, base_timecode_ms, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{startedAt}, #{baseWallClock}, #{baseTimecodeMs}, 'RECORDING') ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET base_wall_clock = EXCLUDED.base_wall_clock, base_timecode_ms = EXCLUDED.base_timecode_ms WHERE recordings.status = 'RECORDING'
